final: WITH g AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(s.points) AS tp, AVG(CAST(s.laps AS REAL)) AS al FROM results s JOIN races r ON r.raceId = s.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS m FROM g) SELECT SUM(tp) AS total_points, AVG(al) AS avg_avg_laps, AVG(tp - (SELECT m FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM g WHERE tp > (SELECT m FROM a)
